name: @oge-ui/scheduler-engine
description: Framework-free engine behind the OGE UI scheduler: view-model builders, transitive-overlap column layout, lane packing, an RFC 5545 RRULE-subset parser and expander, gesture math, keyboard maps, the editing/recurrence/CRUD core, default config and message catalogs — shared by @oge-ui/scheduler (Angular) and @oge-ui/react-scheduler.
